description: Add separate things.todo.trash and things.todo.restore actions for current non-recurring Task6 to-dos. Classify Trash as destructive and require explicit destructive authorization and confirmation. Classify restore as normal. Reject invalid transitions and unsafe targets. Do not add direct delete or Tombstone2 purge. Preserve the one-POST, no-retry, exact verification, and outcome-unknown contracts. Add fake-based safety tests.

comments.text: Exposed separate guarded Trash and restore actions. Trash is a destructive core action and also requires cumulative provider high-risk and destructive gates. Restore is normal risk. Invalid transitions and unsafe targets fail before POST. Direct delete and tombstone writes remain outside the serializer. Package quality passed with 62 tests and 81.02% coverage. Root quality and demo checks passed.

title: Add guarded Things Trash and restore actions
